meta.description: The Two Princesses and the Robot General

units.rawText: Countless little bubbles merge with each other until they form a single gigantic bubble that envelops Aegis.
units.displayText: Countless little bubbles merge with each other until they form a single gigantic bubble that envelops Aegis.

spans.text: Countless little bubbles merge with each other until they form a single gigantic bubble that envelops Aegis.

units.rawText: The longer danmaku simply bounce off, while the shorter ones are trapped between the smaller bubbles and rapidly neutralized.
units.displayText: The longer danmaku simply bounce off, while the shorter ones are trapped between the smaller bubbles and rapidly neutralized.

spans.text: The longer danmaku simply bounce off, while the shorter ones are trapped between the smaller bubbles and rapidly neutralized.

units.rawText: Wow... So these bubbles can ward off danmaku?
units.displayText: Wow... So these bubbles can ward off danmaku?

spans.text: Wow... So these bubbles can ward off danmaku?

units.rawText: How is it even possible? I need to look into it...
units.displayText: How is it even possible? I need to look into it...

spans.text: How is it even possible? I need to look into it...

units.rawText: Gaooo?
units.displayText: Gaooo?

spans.text: Gaooo?

units.rawText: Now! Everyone, chaaaaarge—
units.displayText: Now! Everyone, chaaaaarge—

spans.text: Now! Everyone, chaaaaarge—

units.rawText: (Clattering)
units.displayText: (Clattering)

spans.text: (Clattering)

units.rawText: The sound of mechanical parts engaging pours out like a tidal wave as many mini-robots emerge from the breach in the wall and rush toward the evil dragon.
units.displayText: The sound of mechanical parts engaging pours out like a tidal wave as many mini-robots emerge from the breach in the wall and rush toward the evil dragon.

spans.text: The sound of mechanical parts engaging pours out like a tidal wave as many mini-robots emerge from the breach in the wall and rush toward the evil dragon.

units.rawText: Go, go, go! Slay the evil dragon!
units.displayText: Go, go, go! Slay the evil dragon!

spans.text: Go, go, go! Slay the evil dragon!

units.rawText: Victory to Pyrewood!
units.displayText: Victory to Pyrewood!

spans.text: Victory to Pyrewood!

units.rawText: Ababababa!
units.displayText: Ababababa!

spans.text: Ababababa!

units.rawText: Is it me, or did they slip something weird in there?
units.displayText: Is it me, or did they slip something weird in there?

spans.text: Is it me, or did they slip something weird in there?

units.rawText: Professor, let's go!
units.displayText: Professor, let's go!

spans.text: Professor, let's go!

units.rawText: Got it!
units.displayText: Got it!

spans.text: Got it!

units.rawText: Rooooar—!!
units.displayText: Rooooar—!!

spans.text: Rooooar—!!

units.rawText: The counterattack is so sudden that even the evil dragon can't respond to it in time.
units.displayText: The counterattack is so sudden that even the evil dragon can't respond to it in time.

spans.text: The counterattack is so sudden that even the evil dragon can't respond to it in time.

units.rawText: Professor, check page 2004 of the dictionary... er, I mean, the manual, item SF33!
units.displayText: Professor, check page 2004 of the dictionary... er, I mean, the manual, item SF33!

spans.text: Professor, check page 2004 of the dictionary... er, I mean, the manual, item SF33!

units.rawText: Got it. Kouryuken! Forward + Down + Down-Forward + A + B + A + B!
units.displayText: Got it. Kouryuken! Forward + Down + Down-Forward + A + B + A + B!

spans.text: Got it. Kouryuken! Forward + Down + Down-Forward + A + B + A + B!

units.rawText: Thump—
units.displayText: Thump—

spans.text: Thump—

units.rawText: Gameeeehhh—
units.displayText: Gameeeehhh—

spans.text: Gameeeehhh—

units.rawText: The evil dragon is vanquished, and it flees in terror, leaving strange danmaku in the air as it goes.
units.displayText: The evil dragon is vanquished, and it flees in terror, leaving strange danmaku in the air as it goes.

spans.text: The evil dragon is vanquished, and it flees in terror, leaving strange danmaku in the air as it goes.

units.rawText: Now that the battle is over, Aegis' transformation ends as well. We follow the path that the mini-robots have cleared for us and arrive at the main gate of Pyrewood.
units.displayText: Now that the battle is over, Aegis' transformation ends as well. We follow the path that the mini-robots have cleared for us and arrive at the main gate of Pyrewood.

spans.text: Now that the battle is over, Aegis' transformation ends as well. We follow the path that the mini-robots have cleared for us and arrive at the main gate of Pyrewood.

units.rawText: A girl jumps down from the city wall and runs up to us.
units.displayText: A girl jumps down from the city wall and runs up to us.

spans.text: A girl jumps down from the city wall and runs up to us.

units.rawText: Well done! That robot just now was really cool!
units.displayText: Well done! That robot just now was really cool!

spans.text: Well done! That robot just now was really cool!

units.rawText: Aegis would have been done for if not for your bubbles just now.
units.displayText: Aegis would have been done for if not for your bubbles just now.

spans.text: Aegis would have been done for if not for your bubbles just now.

units.rawText: So Mr. Robot's name was Aegis. Not bad!
units.displayText: So Mr. Robot's name was Aegis. Not bad!

spans.text: So Mr. Robot's name was Aegis. Not bad!

units.rawText: Well, it IS pretty cool. What's your name, anyway? I'm Croquette, though you don't have to remember it.
units.displayText: Well, it IS pretty cool. What's your name, anyway? I'm Croquette, though you don't have to remember it.

spans.text: Well, it IS pretty cool. What's your name, anyway? I'm Croquette, though you don't have to remember it.

units.rawText: I'm Chelsea, the second princess of Pyrewood.
units.displayText: I'm Chelsea, the second princess of Pyrewood.

spans.text: I'm Chelsea, the second princess of Pyrewood.

units.rawText: Why not Li'l Chelsea, and why is a princess wearing a swimsuit, anyway?
units.displayText: Why not Li'l Chelsea, and why is a princess wearing a swimsuit, anyway?

spans.text: Why not Li'l Chelsea, and why is a princess wearing a swimsuit, anyway?

units.rawText: Um... I forbid you to use my original name! It's too uncool!
units.displayText: Um... I forbid you to use my original name! It's too uncool!

spans.text: Um... I forbid you to use my original name! It's too uncool!

units.rawText: As for my outfit, it's the battle attire that's best suited for movement in Pyrewood.
units.displayText: As for my outfit, it's the battle attire that's best suited for movement in Pyrewood.

spans.text: As for my outfit, it's the battle attire that's best suited for movement in Pyrewood.

units.rawText: I suppose not going by Li'l Chelsea because it's uncool is very much in keeping with your nature.
units.displayText: I suppose not going by Li'l Chelsea because it's uncool is very much in keeping with your nature.

spans.text: I suppose not going by Li'l Chelsea because it's uncool is very much in keeping with your nature.

units.rawText: A princess should be proper, refined and elegant. That's what Big Sis taught me. As for you, Croquette, why did you say I didn't have to remember your name?
units.displayText: A princess should be proper, refined and elegant. That's what Big Sis taught me. As for you, Croquette, why did you say I didn't have to remember your name?

spans.text: A princess should be proper, refined and elegant. That's what Big Sis taught me. As for you, Croquette, why did you say I didn't have to remember your name?

units.rawText: My name isn't important, only that I'm the designer of the Aegis mecha!
units.displayText: My name isn't important, only that I'm the designer of the Aegis mecha!

spans.text: My name isn't important, only that I'm the designer of the Aegis mecha!

units.rawText: Hm, I suppose. Can you summon Aegis again?
units.displayText: Hm, I suppose. Can you summon Aegis again?

spans.text: Hm, I suppose. Can you summon Aegis again?

units.rawText: I can, provided I can replenish its power...
units.displayText: I can, provided I can replenish its power...

spans.text: I can, provided I can replenish its power...

units.rawText: Are you going to use Aegis to defend Pyrewood?
units.displayText: Are you going to use Aegis to defend Pyrewood?

spans.text: Are you going to use Aegis to defend Pyrewood?

units.rawText: Of course not!
units.displayText: Of course not!

spans.text: Of course not!

units.rawText: Chelsea laughs smugly and raises the water gun in her hand.
units.displayText: Chelsea laughs smugly and raises the water gun in her hand.

spans.text: Chelsea laughs smugly and raises the water gun in her hand.

units.rawText: I'm going to fight back! I can't let the evil dragon do as it pleases to Pyrewood and force us to offer it sacrifices. We need to strike back at it!
units.displayText: I'm going to fight back! I can't let the evil dragon do as it pleases to Pyrewood and force us to offer it sacrifices. We need to strike back at it!

spans.text: I'm going to fight back! I can't let the evil dragon do as it pleases to Pyrewood and force us to offer it sacrifices. We need to strike back at it!

units.rawText: Can you defeat the evil dragon?
units.displayText: Can you defeat the evil dragon?

spans.text: Can you defeat the evil dragon?

units.rawText: With Aegis helping us, I'm sure we can!
units.displayText: With Aegis helping us, I'm sure we can!

spans.text: With Aegis helping us, I'm sure we can!

units.rawText: If we defeat the evil dragon, the villagers won't have to leave the homes they've known for so many years...
units.displayText: If we defeat the evil dragon, the villagers won't have to leave the homes they've known for so many years...

spans.text: If we defeat the evil dragon, the villagers won't have to leave the homes they've known for so many years...

units.rawText: Alright, I'll work with you.
units.displayText: Alright, I'll work with you.

spans.text: Alright, I'll work with you.

units.rawText: I expected nothing less of the designer of Aegis. Let's send that evil dragon blasting off at the speed of light!
units.displayText: I expected nothing less of the designer of Aegis. Let's send that evil dragon blasting off at the speed of light!

spans.text: I expected nothing less of the designer of Aegis. Let's send that evil dragon blasting off at the speed of light!

units.rawText: But Your Highness, can Aegis reach the evil dragon's fortress?
units.displayText: But Your Highness, can Aegis reach the evil dragon's fortress?

spans.text: But Your Highness, can Aegis reach the evil dragon's fortress?

units.rawText: Hm— Yeah, that's a problem.
units.displayText: Hm— Yeah, that's a problem.

spans.text: Hm— Yeah, that's a problem.

units.rawText: Does the evil dragon live far away?
units.displayText: Does the evil dragon live far away?

spans.text: Does the evil dragon live far away?

units.rawText: That's not what I mean. The truth is, the evil dragon lives in Castle "Heavenly Dragon Livestream" atop Mt. "Cheers" next door.
units.displayText: That's not what I mean. The truth is, the evil dragon lives in Castle "Heavenly Dragon Livestream" atop Mt. "Cheers" next door.

spans.text: That's not what I mean. The truth is, the evil dragon lives in Castle "Heavenly Dragon Livestream" atop Mt. "Cheers" next door.

units.rawText: However a river of "fans" runs around the castle. My mini-robots can't cross it.
units.displayText: However a river of "fans" runs around the castle. My mini-robots can't cross it.

spans.text: However a river of "fans" runs around the castle. My mini-robots can't cross it.

units.rawText: The first princess of Pyrewood made a prediction about the defeat of the evil dragon.
units.displayText: The first princess of Pyrewood made a prediction about the defeat of the evil dragon.

spans.text: The first princess of Pyrewood made a prediction about the defeat of the evil dragon.

units.rawText: Chelsea changes her tone and affects a cute little girl's voice.
units.displayText: Chelsea changes her tone and affects a cute little girl's voice.

spans.text: Chelsea changes her tone and affects a cute little girl's voice.

units.rawText: "Only with an endless army of shills can one cross the river of fans."
units.displayText: "Only with an endless army of shills can one cross the river of fans."

spans.text: "Only with an endless army of shills can one cross the river of fans."

units.rawText: Sounds like fighting fire with fire.
units.displayText: Sounds like fighting fire with fire.

spans.text: Sounds like fighting fire with fire.

units.rawText: However, we have no idea what these "shills" are. Do you know, perhaps?
units.displayText: However, we have no idea what these "shills" are. Do you know, perhaps?

spans.text: However, we have no idea what these "shills" are. Do you know, perhaps?

units.rawText: Shills, fans, livestreams, attacking with danmaku... A clear picture of someone comes to mind.
units.displayText: Shills, fans, livestreams, attacking with danmaku... A clear picture of someone comes to mind.

spans.text: Shills, fans, livestreams, attacking with danmaku... A clear picture of someone comes to mind.

units.rawText: If my guess is right, I know how to turn your army of mini-robots into one of shills.
units.displayText: If my guess is right, I know how to turn your army of mini-robots into one of shills.

spans.text: If my guess is right, I know how to turn your army of mini-robots into one of shills.

units.rawText: Really?! You know how to conjure up an army of shills?
units.displayText: Really?! You know how to conjure up an army of shills?

spans.text: Really?! You know how to conjure up an army of shills?

units.rawText: The scholars of Pyrewood haven't found the answer even after searching half of Arnina!
units.displayText: The scholars of Pyrewood haven't found the answer even after searching half of Arnina!

spans.text: The scholars of Pyrewood haven't found the answer even after searching half of Arnina!

units.rawText: If you know what shills are, I will reward you richly!
units.displayText: If you know what shills are, I will reward you richly!

spans.text: If you know what shills are, I will reward you richly!

units.rawText: It's a bit too early to speak of that right now, and I'm not sure if my methods are right. Let me give it a try.
units.displayText: It's a bit too early to speak of that right now, and I'm not sure if my methods are right. Let me give it a try.

spans.text: It's a bit too early to speak of that right now, and I'm not sure if my methods are right. Let me give it a try.

units.rawText: Then what are we waiting for? Come, I'll take you to our barracks!
units.displayText: Then what are we waiting for? Come, I'll take you to our barracks!

spans.text: Then what are we waiting for? Come, I'll take you to our barracks!

units.rawText: Inside Pyrewood.
units.displayText: Inside Pyrewood.

spans.text: Inside Pyrewood.

units.rawText: Chelsea, was the first princess of Pyrewood you were talking about Princess Nanaka?
units.displayText: Chelsea, was the first princess of Pyrewood you were talking about Princess Nanaka?

spans.text: Chelsea, was the first princess of Pyrewood you were talking about Princess Nanaka?

units.rawText: You know Big Sis too?
units.displayText: You know Big Sis too?

spans.text: You know Big Sis too?

units.rawText: Everyone in Arnina knows her. Princess Nanaka of Pyrewood is the princess with the best singing and dancing.
units.displayText: Everyone in Arnina knows her. Princess Nanaka of Pyrewood is the princess with the best singing and dancing.

spans.text: Everyone in Arnina knows her. Princess Nanaka of Pyrewood is the princess with the best singing and dancing.

units.rawText: And she's really kind too. She helped out villages many times, but...
units.displayText: And she's really kind too. She helped out villages many times, but...

spans.text: And she's really kind too. She helped out villages many times, but...

units.rawText: Ever since the Great Winter started, we haven't heard from her again.
units.displayText: Ever since the Great Winter started, we haven't heard from her again.

spans.text: Ever since the Great Winter started, we haven't heard from her again.

units.rawText: That's because Big Sis had to go into a long sleep to make that prediction...
units.displayText: That's because Big Sis had to go into a long sleep to make that prediction...

spans.text: That's because Big Sis had to go into a long sleep to make that prediction...

units.rawText: A look of sadness crosses Chelsea's face, but she soon shakes it off.
units.displayText: A look of sadness crosses Chelsea's face, but she soon shakes it off.

spans.text: A look of sadness crosses Chelsea's face, but she soon shakes it off.

units.rawText: Still, that doesn't matter! I'll wake Big Sis up and defeat the evil dragon, then clean it up into a good dragon with my high-pressure water gun!
units.displayText: Still, that doesn't matter! I'll wake Big Sis up and defeat the evil dragon, then clean it up into a good dragon with my high-pressure water gun!

spans.text: Still, that doesn't matter! I'll wake Big Sis up and defeat the evil dragon, then clean it up into a good dragon with my high-pressure water gun!

units.rawText: Are you sure of it?
units.displayText: Are you sure of it?

spans.text: Are you sure of it?

units.rawText: I'm sure Big Sis' prediction is correct. Plus, your arrival already proved that part of it was true!
units.displayText: I'm sure Big Sis' prediction is correct. Plus, your arrival already proved that part of it was true!

spans.text: I'm sure Big Sis' prediction is correct. Plus, your arrival already proved that part of it was true!

units.rawText: You mean the prediction wrote about me too?
units.displayText: You mean the prediction wrote about me too?

spans.text: You mean the prediction wrote about me too?

units.rawText: Listen— "Once the massive monster arrives at Pyrewood, its tears will give rise to the final hope."
units.displayText: Listen— "Once the massive monster arrives at Pyrewood, its tears will give rise to the final hope."

spans.text: Listen— "Once the massive monster arrives at Pyrewood, its tears will give rise to the final hope."

units.rawText: That massive monster might be Aegis!
units.displayText: That massive monster might be Aegis!

spans.text: That massive monster might be Aegis!

units.rawText: That sounds pretty cool, but Aegis can't cry. I didn't design it to do so.
units.displayText: That sounds pretty cool, but Aegis can't cry. I didn't design it to do so.

spans.text: That sounds pretty cool, but Aegis can't cry. I didn't design it to do so.

units.rawText: Um... Then maybe the prediction isn't complete! I mean, it's always like that in storybooks, right? Predictions are always vague riddles.
units.displayText: Um... Then maybe the prediction isn't complete! I mean, it's always like that in storybooks, right? Predictions are always vague riddles.

spans.text: Um... Then maybe the prediction isn't complete! I mean, it's always like that in storybooks, right? Predictions are always vague riddles.

units.rawText: Really? It seems kind of weird, though...
units.displayText: Really? It seems kind of weird, though...

spans.text: Really? It seems kind of weird, though...

units.rawText: Just as Croquette is muttering to herself, a stern mechanical voice booms forth.
units.displayText: Just as Croquette is muttering to herself, a stern mechanical voice booms forth.

spans.text: Just as Croquette is muttering to herself, a stern mechanical voice booms forth.

units.rawText: Which noisy miscreant dares barge into this vital garrison?
units.displayText: Which noisy miscreant dares barge into this vital garrison?

spans.text: Which noisy miscreant dares barge into this vital garrison?

units.rawText: Your Excellency! It's me! I found the prophesized person chosen by the heavens! Pyrewood is saved!
units.displayText: Your Excellency! It's me! I found the prophesized person chosen by the heavens! Pyrewood is saved!

spans.text: Your Excellency! It's me! I found the prophesized person chosen by the heavens! Pyrewood is saved!

units.rawText: What? Such a talented individual exists outside our Pyrewood? Did you recruit some charlatan sorcerer, perhaps?
units.displayText: What? Such a talented individual exists outside our Pyrewood? Did you recruit some charlatan sorcerer, perhaps?

spans.text: What? Such a talented individual exists outside our Pyrewood? Did you recruit some charlatan sorcerer, perhaps?

units.rawText: Ahem, I am no prestidigitator and neither can I interpret prophecies, but I can turn your army into one of shills.
units.displayText: Ahem, I am no prestidigitator and neither can I interpret prophecies, but I can turn your army into one of shills.

spans.text: Ahem, I am no prestidigitator and neither can I interpret prophecies, but I can turn your army into one of shills.

units.rawText: May I inspect your troops?
units.displayText: May I inspect your troops?

spans.text: May I inspect your troops?

units.rawText: Harrumph! Very well, I shall bring them forth for review!
units.displayText: Harrumph! Very well, I shall bring them forth for review!

spans.text: Harrumph! Very well, I shall bring them forth for review!

units.rawText: The mini-robot general eyes me with suspicion as it brings me into the depths of the encampment.
units.displayText: The mini-robot general eyes me with suspicion as it brings me into the depths of the encampment.

spans.text: The mini-robot general eyes me with suspicion as it brings me into the depths of the encampment.

units.rawText: Greetings, General and Your Highness!
units.displayText: Greetings, General and Your Highness!

spans.text: Greetings, General and Your Highness!

units.rawText: As expected, all the troops in the camp are mini-robots who look just like the ones from Helios. The difference is that their face-monitors are blank.
units.displayText: As expected, all the troops in the camp are mini-robots who look just like the ones from Helios. The difference is that their face-monitors are blank.

spans.text: As expected, all the troops in the camp are mini-robots who look just like the ones from Helios. The difference is that their face-monitors are blank.

units.rawText: Shills are beings who can ignore the stream host and resist the danmaku of fans.
units.displayText: Shills are beings who can ignore the stream host and resist the danmaku of fans.

spans.text: Shills are beings who can ignore the stream host and resist the danmaku of fans.

units.rawText: Therefore, if we can train these robots with those danmaku, we should be able to turn them into an army of shills.
units.displayText: Therefore, if we can train these robots with those danmaku, we should be able to turn them into an army of shills.

spans.text: Therefore, if we can train these robots with those danmaku, we should be able to turn them into an army of shills.

units.rawText: Is it truly so simple? Are you deceiving me, perhaps?
units.displayText: Is it truly so simple? Are you deceiving me, perhaps?

spans.text: Is it truly so simple? Are you deceiving me, perhaps?

units.rawText: Leave it to me! I'll head outside and bring the danmaku in here!
units.displayText: Leave it to me! I'll head outside and bring the danmaku in here!

spans.text: Leave it to me! I'll head outside and bring the danmaku in here!

units.rawText: Croquette, come with me!
units.displayText: Croquette, come with me!

spans.text: Croquette, come with me!

units.rawText: Chelsea grabs Croquette's hand and runs outside with her.
units.displayText: Chelsea grabs Croquette's hand and runs outside with her.

spans.text: Chelsea grabs Croquette's hand and runs outside with her.

units.rawText: Wait, don't just grab me like that, suddenly getting so close to others is weird!
units.displayText: Wait, don't just grab me like that, suddenly getting so close to others is weird!

spans.text: Wait, don't just grab me like that, suddenly getting so close to others is weird!

units.rawText: Oh, this is nothing! Don't be so shy. We're already comrades, aren't we?
units.displayText: Oh, this is nothing! Don't be so shy. We're already comrades, aren't we?

spans.text: Oh, this is nothing! Don't be so shy. We're already comrades, aren't we?

units.displayText: The two girls' happy voices fade into the distance.

units.displayText: Soon, Chelsea and Croquette return from outside the city gates with the danmaku that the evil dragon left behind when it fled.

spans.text: Soon, Chelsea and Croquette return from outside the city gates with the danmaku that the evil dragon left behind when it fled.
